name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces and Assam Rifles (PMSS-MHA)
provider: Ministry of Home Affairs (Welfare and Rehabilitation Board) under the National Defence Fund

value: CAPF / Assam Rifles personnel (PBOR), deceased/disabled/retired/serving; widows
rules.quote: Wards/widows of retired and serving CAPFs & AR Personnel. (Personnel below Officer Rank)

value: first professional degree (Engg, Medicine, Dental, Veterinary, BBA, BCA, B.Pharma, B.Sc Nursing/Agri, MBA, MCA)
rules.quote: Pursuing first professional degree programme in the field of Engineering, Medicine, Dental, Veterinary, BBA, BCA, B. Pharma, B.SC (Nursing, Agriculture, etc.), MBA and MCA etc.
Having minimum 60% marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (MEQ) i.e. 10+2/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent in case of new applicant.
it is mandatory to pass the each subsequent academic year of the professional courses being pursued by them with minimum 50% marks
This scholarship is admissible for only two Children per family

rules.value: 2000 scholarships for CAPF/AR wards; order of preference categories A-G
rules.quote: PMSS is meant for wards/widows of uniformed / combat CAPFs, AR & States/UTs Police personnel
Applicants pursuing courses, such as Diploma courses, not leading to award of a degree or pursuing master degree programme except MBA, MCA subject to first professional course.
Applicants availing benefit of other scholarship scheme/getting stipend and financial assistance.

amount.text: Rs 3,000 per month for girls (Rs 36,000 p.a.); Rs 2,500 per month for boys (Rs 30,000 p.a.); up to 5 years
amount.quote: Rs. 3000/-per month for girls . To be paid annually after selection. II. Rs. 2500/- per month for boys @ Rs 36,000/-to each girl & Rs 30,000/- to each boy

documents.name: Service certificate from Head of Office (serving personnel)
documents.quote: Service Certificate to be issued by the H.O.O in case of serving personnel as per Annexure- A.

documents.name: MEQ marksheet plus PPO/discharge, disability, death or gallantry certificate as applicable
documents.quote: PPO/Discharge Certificate/Book (Mandatory for category A to F) b) Disability Certificate (Mandatory for category B & D) c) Death Certificate (Mandatory for category A & C) d) Certificate of Gallantry award (Mandatory for category E)
